Name: Craftable Fish Bowl
Author: HopeWasHere
Description:
[center][b][b]Update 1/3/2019
[/b][/b]Sorry for the wait everyone. This mod has finally been updated for 1.3 and the updated Custom Farming Redux. Along side this update I've released a new Animal Furniture mod, that can be found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3212]here[/url]﻿. I recommend using that mod instead. It includes the fish bowl found in this mod, plus a few more animals, none of which you have to craft. This mod is here more for people who liked the original or like crafting their fish bowl for some reason.

This mod no longer needs Custom Element Handler, only Custom Farming Redux and whatever it's dependencies are.
[b][b][u][i]

[/i][/u]Old Information[u][i]

For troubleshooting, please head to the official discussion page![/i][/u][/b]

Craftable Fish Bowl

[/b]With the use of [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1068/?]Custom Element Handler[/url] and [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/991/?]Custom Farming[/url] you can now craft a small fish bowl to display in your home!
[i]You will need both of these mods in order to get this mod to work!


[/i]For modders that would like to have the tile sheet for custom .xnb or other projects there is also the Simple Fish Bowl Animation you can download

[img]http://community.playstarbound.com/attachments/fish-bowl-2-gif.183981/[/img]


For more information about this mod and others I've made, head over to the official discussion page:
[url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/hopes-mods.130359/#post-3115777]http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/hopes-mods.130359/#post-3115777[/url]
[/center]
